join_recipes.name: active_sipstp
join_recipes.sql_pattern: sphmf.sipstp s ON dim.folio_number = s.folio_no AND dim.arn_code = s.brok_code JOIN public.scheme_master sm ON s.sch_code = sm.scheme_cd WHERE s.cease_dt IS NULL AND s.to_date > NOW()

join_recipes.name: sip_amount_active
join_recipes.description: Active SIP rows with instalment amount (sipstp.amount) and scheme filter.
join_recipes.sql_pattern: sphmf.sipstp s ON dim.folio_number = s.folio_no AND dim.arn_code = s.brok_code JOIN public.scheme_master sm ON s.sch_code = sm.scheme_cd WHERE s.cease_dt IS NULL AND (s.cancellation_request_date IS NULL) AND s.to_date > NOW() AND s.atrxn_type = 'P' AND s.amount >= %s

join_recipes.name: no_active_sip
join_recipes.description: Investors with no live SIP/STP row (NOT EXISTS active sipstp).
join_recipes.sql_pattern: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sphmf.sipstp s WHERE s.folio_no = dim.folio_number AND s.brok_code = dim.arn_code AND s.cease_dt IS NULL AND (s.cancellation_request_date IS NULL) AND s.to_date > NOW())

user_examples: Active SIPs above 5,000 per month in hybrid funds
sql_hints: Use EXISTS (not wide JOIN) on sipstp + scheme_master; avoid WITH/CTEs that put amount %s before dim.arn_code = %s.
Active SIP: cease_dt NULL, cancellation_request_date NULL, to_date > NOW(), atrxn_type = 'P'.
Amount: s.amount >= %s as second parameter (integer, e.g. 5000 for 'above 5,000 per month').
Hybrid schemes: scheme_type ILIKE '%hybrid%' OR '%balanced%' per filter_vocabulary.scheme_classification.hybrid.
question_patterns.sql_skeleton: SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.uuid) i.uuid, i.first_name, i.last_name, i.email FROM public.distributor_investor_mapping dim JOIN public.investor i ON i.uuid = dim.investor_uuid WHERE dim.arn_code = %s AND EXISTS (  SELECT 1 FROM sphmf.sipstp s   JOIN public.scheme_master sm ON s.sch_code = sm.scheme_cd   WHERE s.folio_no = dim.folio_number AND s.brok_code = dim.arn_code   AND s.cease_dt IS NULL AND s.cancellation_request_date IS NULL AND s.to_date > NOW()   AND s.atrxn_type = 'P' AND s.amount >= %s   AND (lower(sm.scheme_type) LIKE '%%hybrid%%' OR lower(sm.scheme_type) LIKE '%%balanced%%')) ORDER BY i.uuid LIMIT 500

sql_hints: NOT EXISTS active sipstp row for folio+brok_code; see join_recipe no_active_sip.
question_patterns.sql_skeleton: SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.uuid) i.uuid, i.first_name, i.last_name, i.email FROM public.distributor_investor_mapping dim JOIN public.investor i ON i.uuid = dim.investor_uuid WHERE dim.arn_code = %s AND NOT EXISTS (  SELECT 1 FROM sphmf.sipstp s WHERE s.folio_no = dim.folio_number AND s.brok_code = dim.arn_code   AND s.cease_dt IS NULL AND s.cancellation_request_date IS NULL AND s.to_date > NOW()) ORDER BY i.uuid LIMIT 500

predicates: s.to_date IS NOT NULL AND s.to_date > NOW()
s.atrxn_type = 'P' for vanilla SIP (see systematic_plans in filter catalog)
sipstp_active.amount_column: sphmf.sipstp.amount (numeric instalment; compare >= threshold for 'above 5000 per month')

scheme_classification.equity: lower(sm.scheme_type) LIKE '%equity%' OR EXISTS on sphmf.scheme_setup (ss.schcode = pt.sch_code AND lower(ss.asset_class) = 'equity'); public.scheme_master has scheme_type/scheme_name only (no asset_class).
scheme_classification.liquid_cash: lower(sm.scheme_type) LIKE '%liquid%' OR lower(sm.scheme_name) LIKE '%liquid%' OR lower(ss.schname) LIKE '%liquid%' via scheme_setup ss on pt.sch_code = ss.schcode
scheme_classification.cgf: sch_code IN (SELECT schcode FROM sphmf.scheme_setup WHERE cgf_flag = 'C' AND plan_type <> 'D')
